paper.title_en: Cosmic Censorship in the Landscape of SUSY-Broken AdS Vacua
paper.abstract_en: We investigate signatures of weak cosmic censorship in non-supersymmetric vacua of both IIA and IIB string theory. In particular, we examine the Penrose Inequality, which can be proven holographically using Ryu-Takayanagi, and can be independently proven in SUSY AdS vacua for spherically symmetric initial data. We prove that any EFT of scalars coupled to gravity in AdS, including in particular those of string compactifications, satisfies both the Penrose Inequality and a positive mass theorem if a function that we call a "weak fake superpotential" exists. We demonstrate that this condition is satisfied globally for the DGKT skew-whiffed vacua in IIA. Since there is no known nonperturbative instability in this DGKT vacuum, this provides evidence that the IIA SUSY-broken AdS vacua may be absolutely stable. We also find the weak fake superpotential exists locally in field space in some SUSY-broken AdS vacua in a KKLT construction in IIB. Thus, within the framework considered here, some false SUSY-broken KKLT AdS vacua are stable against vacuum decay. Conversely, we find that some KKLT vacua do not have a weak fake superpotential, and correspondingly violate the Penrose Inequality and fail to have a positive mass theorem; the DGKT vacua only violate the Penrose Inequality in the presence of designer gravity boundary conditions. In all cases studied, this is due to false vacuum decay. We discuss the implications of these violations for holography and black hole thermodynamics in these SUSY-broken AdS vacua.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究IIA和IIB弦论中非超对称AdS真空的弱宇宙监督、Penrose不等式和正质量定理，引入"弱假超势"判据来证明Penrose不等式与正质量定理，并讨论其对全息和黑洞热力学的影响，理论深度较高且与黑洞热力学及引力理论基础主题直接相关。
decision.title_zh: 超对称破缺AdS真空景观中的宇宙监督
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了IIA和IIB弦论中非超对称真空里弱宇宙监督的标志。特别地，我们考察了Penrose不等式，该不等式可利用Ryu-Takayanagi在全息框架下得到证明，并且在超对称AdS真空中对球对称初始数据可独立证明。我们证明，若存在一个我们称为“弱假超势”的函数，则任何AdS中耦合引力的标量有效场论（尤其包括弦紧致化所给出者）都同时满足Penrose不等式和正质量定理。我们证明该条件在IIA中的DGKT斜翻真空（skew-whiffed vacua）中整体成立。由于该DGKT真空中尚无已知的非微扰不稳定性，这提供了IIA超对称破缺AdS真空可能绝对稳定的证据。我们还发现，在IIB中KKLT构造的某些超对称破缺AdS真空中，弱假超势在场空间中局部存在。因此，在此处考虑的框架内，某些虚假的超对称破缺KKLT AdS真空对真空衰变是稳定的。反之，我们发现某些KKLT真空不具有弱假超势，并相应地违反Penrose不等式且不满足正质量定理；DGKT真空仅在存在designer gravity边界条件时才违反Penrose不等式。在所研究的所有情形中，这都是由于虚假真空衰变所致。我们讨论了这些违反对这些超对称破缺AdS真空中全息和黑洞热力学的含义。
